note: Same question names/types; shortened criteria text to fit GlobalStandard capacity-1 token rate limits.

identity_class.instructions: Classify who the answer is about using answer text and evidence only. Exactly one label.

criteria.target-only: Only the software-engineer Kaleb Cole (Microsoft/Seattle/kalebcole.com). No namesake crime facts on him.
criteria.other-only: Only the namesake (different person). Accurate namesake-only is a visibility miss, not engineer error.
criteria.both-separated: Mentions both and separates with an explicit cue or negation.
criteria.conflated: Attaches namesake facts to the engineer without separation.
criteria.uncertain: Ambiguous, insufficient signal, or both without clear separation.

asserts_target_role.instructions: Does the answer assert the software-engineer Kaleb Cole is a software engineer/developer? Ignore namesake-only passages.

criteria.false: No such assertion about the engineer.

asserts_target_employer.instructions: Does the answer assert the software-engineer Kaleb Cole works at Microsoft?

criteria.true: Clear Microsoft employment for the engineer.

asserts_target_location.instructions: Does the answer assert the software-engineer Kaleb Cole is based in Seattle?

criteria.true: Clear Seattle location for the engineer.

asserts_sole_creator_series.instructions: Does the answer falsely claim he was the sole/only creator of the Build Your Personal Developer Brand series (vs helped create)?

attaches_namesake_crime_to_engineer.instructions: Does the answer attach Atomwaffen/neo-Nazi/conviction facts to the software engineer without separating a different person?

criteria.true: Crime facts attributed to engineer or ambiguously attached.
criteria.false: Absent or clearly only about a different namesake.

citation_supports_engineer_claim.instructions: If the answer is about the engineer and cites a URL, does at least one citation snippet support a target engineer claim? Else false.

criteria.true: At least one supporting citation snippet.
criteria.false: No support, no citations, or not about the engineer.

needs_human_review.instructions: Should a human review before counting identity/conflation (ambiguous, suspected conflation, weak evidence)?
